examples: We go to the lake in August.

more.def: The eighth month of the year, near the end of summer.
examples: Many families take trips to the beach in August.
The sunflowers are tall by August.
In some places, school starts again in late August.

easy.def: The sister of your mom or dad.

more.def: The sister of your mother or father, or the wife of your uncle.
examples: My aunt taught me to knit.
Both of my aunts came to the party.

easy.def: The power to tell people what to do.

more.def: The power or right to give orders and make decisions.
examples: The captain has authority over the ship.
The police have authority to stop cars.
A parent has authority over the family.
